_what: External published statistics quoted in the manuscript's opening paragraph. Not derived from this project's data: each entry records the figure exactly as the source prints it, with the source, its reference period, its release date and the URL, so tools/check_paper.py can pin what the paper prints against the source rather than against a typist's memory.

herd_2024.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Research and Experimental Development, Higher Education Organisations, Australia
herd_2024.quote_total: Expenditure on R&D performed by Australian higher education organisations during the 2024 calendar year was $16,404 million.
herd_2024.quote_labour: Labour costs remained the largest component of Current expenditure at $7,119 million, and recorded the largest dollar increase, up $1,044 million (17%) in 2024.
